story.fullStory:
Paul Simon's "You Can Call Me Al" reached #23 on the Billboard Hot 100. "You Can Call Me Al" is a song by American singer-songwriter Paul Simon.

It was the lead single from his seventh studio album, Graceland (1986), released on Warner Bros.

Written by Simon, its lyrics follow an individual seemingly experiencing a midlife crisis.

The song peaked at #23 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 29 weeks on the chart.

facts.text: "You Can Call Me Al" is a song by American singer-songwriter Paul Simon.

Graceland is the seventh solo studio album by the American singer-songwriter Paul Simon.
It was produced by Simon, engineered by Roy Halee, and released on August 25, 1986, by Warner Bros.
